title: Engineering → Product
summary: Moving from a hands-on engineering role into product management means trading deep technical execution for cross-functional prioritisation and stakeholder communication.
suggestedSteps: Shadow the product team through a full sprint planning and roadmap review cycle
Own the spec for one feature end-to-end, including the business case
Build a track record of stakeholder-facing communication such as demos and roadmap updates

title: Product → Engineering
summary: Moving from product into engineering means demonstrating hands-on technical depth beyond writing specs and coordinating cross-functionally.
recommendedCerts: A language/framework certification matching the target engineering stack
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (or the equivalent for the target infrastructure)
suggestedSteps: Complete a supervised coding project with the engineering team end-to-end
Pair-program regularly with an engineering mentor for at least one quarter
Contribute fixes or small features to a live codebase under code review

title: Operations → Sales
summary: Moving from operations into sales means building comfort with client-facing conversations, negotiation, and revenue accountability, on top of the process discipline operations already builds.
suggestedSteps: Shadow the sales team on at least 5 client calls
Take pilot ownership of a small account or renewal under a sales mentor
Complete internal sales enablement and product training

title: Product → Design
summary: Moving from product management into design means shifting from prioritisation and roadmap ownership toward hands-on craft: user research, interaction design, and visual execution.
suggestedSteps: Build a portfolio of 2-3 redesign case studies from real product problems
Pair with a designer on a live project for a full release cycle
Reach production-level comfort with the team's design tooling

title: Sales → Marketing
summary: Moving from sales into marketing means shifting from one-to-one persuasion toward one-to-many messaging, campaign strategy, and measurement.
suggestedSteps: Own the messaging for one campaign end-to-end with the marketing team
Build familiarity with the team's marketing analytics stack
Shadow the marketing team through a full campaign cycle, from brief to retro

suggestedSteps: Build a portfolio of 2-3 redesign case studies, drawing on features you've already built
